usage: Used to describe something as real, not fake, especially in shopping or jewellery contexts.
Very common before nouns like jewellery, stones, watches, and brand items when checking authenticity.
Can sound a bit formal in writing, but it is also used naturally in everyday speech and shop talk.
Often contrasts with 假; learners should treat it as a short, basic word for authenticity or genuineness.
